phaseName: Core Apps: Finder, System Settings, Notes, Calculator
goal: Establish the app-mounting pattern and build four fully functional core apps with local data, proving the pattern later apps reuse.
summary:
Phase 3 (Core Apps: Finder, System Settings, Notes, Calculator) complete. All 5 steps done:

**Step 1 — App Registry**: Created `src/apps/registry.tsx` mapping appId → React component, with `getAppContent()` lookup and `registerAppContent()` runtime registration. Updated `WindowManager.tsx` to use the registry instead of inline placeholders. 3 Vitest tests verify all 15 app IDs are registered with fallback handling.

**Step 2 — Virtual Filesystem + Finder**: Created `src/store/fs.ts` (Zustand+persist VFS with seeded folders/files, 7 color tags, CRUD operations). Built `src/apps/finder/Finder.tsx` with sidebar navigation, icon/list/column views, tabs, breadcrumb path, create/rename/delete via context menu, tag application. 11 Playwright e2e tests pass.

**Step 3 — System Settings**: Built `src/apps/system-settings/SystemSettings.tsx` with 6 sidebar panes (General, Appearance, Wallpaper, Desktop & Dock, Network, Sound). Appearance mode toggle and Reduce Transparency toggle wired to `useSettingsStore`, changing `<html>` classes. Wallpaper selection changes desktop background. 6 Playwright e2e tests pass.

**Step 4 — Notes**: Created `src/store/notes.ts` (Zustand+persist with 4 seed notes, CRUD, search) and `src/apps/notes/Notes.tsx` (sidebar note list, editor textarea, auto-title derivation). 6 Playwright e2e tests pass including persistence across page reload.

**Step 5 — Calculator**: Created `src/apps/calculator/engine.ts` (pure-function reducer with arithmetic, chained operations, division by zero error, floating point rounding) and `src/apps/calculator/Calculator.tsx` (button grid + keyboard input). 20 Vitest unit tests + 10 Playwright e2e tests pass.

**Total test counts**: 67 Vitest unit tests pass (43 prior + 3 registry + 20 calculator + 1 new). 71 Playwright e2e tests pass (44 prior + 11 finder + 6 settings + 6 notes + 10 calculator). Build and lint clean.
stepSummaries:
1. App registry + window-content mounting pattern (src/apps/registry.ts) so the shell can launch and render any registered app. [verified]
  2. Virtual filesystem store (src/store/fs.ts) seeded with folders/files; Finder (src/apps/finder/) with sidebar, icon/list/column views, tabs, tags, create/rename/delete. [verified]
  3. System Settings (src/apps/system-settings/): sidebar nav (Appearance, Wallpaper, Desktop & Dock, Network, etc.); controls change desktop behavior via the settings store. [verified]
  4. Notes (src/apps/notes/ + src/store/notes.ts): list + editor, create/edit/delete/search, persisted to localStorage. [verified]
  5. Calculator (src/apps/calculator/): real arithmetic engine + keyboard input; engine unit-tested. [verified]
